# m8/help-at-map-120x36: drawn by `view::view` from a real AppState

# keys; EVERYWHERE the Global keys that act here; no `c commit`, `R`, `m merge`,
# `/ Find…`.

            │ ›                                                                                            │

            │ S     Stash…                                                                    graph.stash  │
            │ J     Undo journal                                                            graph.journal  │
            │ EVERYWHERE                                                                                   │
            │ j     Move down                                                                    app.down  │
            │ k     Move up                                                                        app.up  │
            │ esc   Back out / close / cancel                                                    app.back  │
            │ ⌃P    Command palette                                                           app.palette  │
            │ ?     Help for this place                                                          app.help  │
            │ u     Undo                                                                         app.undo  │
            │ U     Redo                                                                         app.redo  │
            │ ⌃R    Refresh                                                                   app.refresh  │
